notes: Added schema/contract, core enforcement logic, API boundary validation, and integration test coverage stories.

GPTR-F-001-S43.title: Request Schema and Contract Validation
GPTR-F-001-S43.description: Define and enforce strict Pydantic schema for all GPTReader request payloads including collection, filters, projection, and limits. Reject any request not conforming to schema before allowlist evaluation.

GPTR-F-001-S44.title: Core Allowlist Enforcement Engine
GPTR-F-001-S44.description: Implement core validation engine that enforces allowlisted collections, fields, operators, and query constraints. Engine must evaluate every request deterministically and block any non-compliant access.

GPTR-F-001-S45.title: API Boundary Enforcement Layer
GPTR-F-001-S45.description: Integrate enforcement engine into Azure Function entrypoint ensuring all inbound GPTReader requests pass through validation before any database or downstream call is executed.

GPTR-F-001-S46.title: Negative and Edge Case Security Tests
GPTR-F-001-S46.description: Create unit and integration tests covering invalid schema, disallowed fields, operator injection attempts, oversized queries, and malformed payloads to verify strict rejection behavior.
